title: Payment Repair Policy
rule_text: Validate format/checksum/country; repair only with corroborating beneficiary/history evidence.

title: Routing Repair Policy
rule_text: Use approved BIC reference and corridor evidence; do not infer unsupported routing.

title: Duplicate Payment Policy
rule_text: Compare parties, amount, currency, timing and references; escalate ambiguous matches.

title: Sanctions Investigation Policy
rule_text: Potential matches remain on hold until authorized compliance disposition.

title: KYC Remediation Policy
rule_text: Expired KYC requires remediation; grace periods must be explicitly supported by policy.

title: Payment Return Policy
rule_text: Interpret return code and downstream reason before repair/resubmission.
